_comment: Cards that exist only for the face-down-exile test (tests/unit/test_exile_top_face_down.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_necro_impulse` is Necropotence's third line, which is the whole capability in one ability: exile the top card face down, name it with `as`, and let a `your_turn` delay hand back exactly that card. `t_open_impulse` is the same ability without `face_down`, so the test can tell the privacy apart from the move.

cards.name: Test Necro Impulse
cards.oracle_text: Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library face down. Put that card into your hand at the beginning of your next end step.

abilities.text: Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library face down. Put that card into your hand at the beginning of your next end step.

effects.text: Put that card into your hand at the beginning of your next end step.

cards.name: Test Open Impulse
cards.oracle_text: Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library.

abilities.text: Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library.
